places.name: Thracian Tomb of Kazanlak (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The Thracian Tomb of Kazanlak is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its well-preserved murals and historical significance.
places.place_tip: Photography is not allowed inside the tomb.

places.name: Rose Museum
places.ai_summary: The Rose Museum in Kazanlak celebrates Bulgaria’s rose oil industry, showcasing its history and cultural importance.
places.place_tip: Visit during the Rose Festival for a more immersive experience.

places.name: Rose Festival (June)
places.ai_summary: The Rose Festival is an annual celebration in Kazanlak, featuring parades, traditional dances, and rose-picking rituals.

opening_hours.notes: Check the official schedule for event timings.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot for the parade.

places.name: Shipka Memorial Church
places.ai_summary: The Shipka Memorial Church, also known as the Church of the Nativity, is a prominent Bulgarian Orthodox church located in the Shipka Pass.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the impressive bell tower.

places.name: Shipka Pass Monument
places.ai_summary: The Shipka Pass Monument is a commemorative monument located at the Shipka Pass, honoring the Bulgarian and Russian soldiers who fought in the Russo-Turkish War.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: The views from the monument are breathtaking.

places.name: Buzludzha Monument (UFO Building)
places.ai_summary: The Buzludzha Monument, also known as the UFO Building, is a former Communist Party headquarters, now a ruin and a popular tourist attraction.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted due to weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Explore the interior for unique photo opportunities.

places.name: Damascena Rose Oil Distillery
places.ai_summary: The Damascena Rose Oil Distillery is a renowned producer of rose oil, offering tours and tastings to visitors.
places.place_tip: Participate in a rose picking tour for a unique experience.

attribution.title: Bulgarian Rose

places.name: Tomb of Seuthes III (Golyama Kosmatka)
places.ai_summary: The Tomb of Seuthes III, also known as Golyama Kosmatka, is an ancient Thracian tomb, notable for its large burial mound and rich grave goods.
places.place_tip: The site is best explored with a guide.

places.name: Ethnographic Complex Etar (Gabrovo)
places.ai_summary: The Ethnographic Complex Etar is an open-air museum near Gabrovo, showcasing traditional Bulgarian crafts, architecture, and lifestyle.
places.place_tip: Try to visit during a traditional craft demonstration.

places.name: Tryavna Old Town Walk
places.ai_summary: The Tryavna Old Town Walk is a scenic walking tour through the historic center of Tryavna, known for its well-preserved Renaissance architecture.
places.place_tip: Visit the Clock Tower and the Old Bridge.

places.name: National Museum of Education (Gabrovo)
places.ai_summary: The National Museum of Education in Gabrovo is dedicated to the history of education in Bulgaria, featuring exhibits and artifacts from various periods.
places.place_tip: Check for any temporary exhibitions during your visit.

attribution.title: Sofia - National Museum of History
attribution.author: Ann Wuyts
attribution.description: The museum was moved to a former governmental residence at Boyana in 2000 and currently stores and owns over 650,000 objects, with about 10% of those on display.

places.name: Dryanovo Monastery
places.ai_summary: The Dryanovo Monastery, also known as the Monastery of the Holy Archangels Michael and Gabriel, is a Bulgarian Orthodox monastery with a rich history.
places.place_tip: Attend a liturgy service for a unique experience.

places.name: Etar Craft Street
places.ai_summary: Etar Craft Street is a picturesque street in the Etar Architectural-Ethnographic Complex, featuring traditional Bulgarian crafts and workshops.
places.place_tip: Watch artisans at work and purchase unique souvenirs.

places.name: Buzludzha Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: The Buzludzha Viewpoint offers a panoramic view of the surrounding mountains and valleys, and is a popular spot for photography.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: The viewpoint is accessible by a short hike.

places.name: Rose Fields in Bloom (May–June)
places.ai_summary: The Rose Fields in Bloom is a seasonal attraction in the Kazanlak region, where visitors can see and smell the stunning rose fields during the blooming season.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and enjoy the fragrance of the roses.

places.name: Koprivshtitsa Historic Houses
places.ai_summary: The Koprivshtitsa Historic Houses are a group of well-preserved 19th-century houses in the town of Koprivshtitsa, showcasing the Bulgarian National Revival architecture.
places.place_tip: Explore the interior of the houses for a glimpse into the past.

places.name: Museum of Humour (Gabrovo)
places.ai_summary: The Museum of Humour in Gabrovo is a unique museum dedicated to humor and satire, featuring a collection of humorous exhibits and artworks.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the humorous sculptures in the garden.

attribution.title: TownHall Gabrovo
attribution.author: MrPanyGoff
attribution.description: The Town Hall in Gabrovo, Bulgaria.

places.name: Central Balkan National Park Trails
places.ai_summary: The Central Balkan National Park offers a network of trails for hiking and exploring the stunning nature and biodiversity of the region.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring and summer months.

places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and wear sturdy hiking shoes.

places.name: Byala Reka Eco Trail
places.ai_summary: The Byala Reka Eco Trail is a scenic eco-trail in the Central Balkan National Park, known for its beautiful landscapes and rich biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the spring and summer months.

places.place_tip: Look out for the diverse wildlife along the trail.
places.address: Byala Reka, Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria

places.name: Photo Point: Shipka Monument Sunset
places.ai_summary: The Photo Point near the Shipka Monument is a popular spot for capturing stunning sunsets over the Shipka Pass.
places.place_tip: Bring a tripod for the best sunset photos.
